name: floor-2-rafters-app
description: Floor 2 Rafters for iPhone and Android: the website in public/ wrapped with Capacitor.

scripts.add:android: npm run web && npx cap add android && npm run icons -- --android && npm run native && npx cap sync android
scripts.add:ios: npm run web && npx cap add ios && npm run icons -- --ios && npm run native && npx cap sync ios
scripts.setup: npm run add:ios && npm run add:android
scripts.sync: npm run web && npm run native && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
